userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: An exit read of the vehicle closed the Session.
The same vehicle was read entering again with no exit seen; the earlier Session was closed at the new entry.
No exit was seen within the implementation's limit and a rule closed the Session (SessionClosure.rule names it).
A nested-area Session closed because the visit it is part of (SessionDetail.parent) ended.
The vehicle was read leaving a nested area while staying in the facility.
An inventory or patrol sweep found the vehicle gone.
The vehicle was handed back to its owner by valet (Part 22).
An exit with no observed entry; the Session exists only to account for the exit (SessionClosure.startObserved is false).
A person closed the Session by hand.
A reviewer paired the exit to the Session.
